name: Shotstack
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Hosted video rendering: submit a JSON edit, receive a rendered file
summary: Cloud video API: you POST a JSON timeline (clips, titles, audio, effects) to the Edit API and poll or receive a webhook for the rendered video, image or audio file. Driven by plain HTTP or the SDKs; output is a hosted video file. Strength is rendering with no local FFmpeg or browser, at the cost of uploads, per-render fees and an account key.
use_when: Render must run without local compute and a JSON edit describes it well
Templated batch video where per-minute pricing beats owning render hardware
avoid_when: Local, frame-exact browser scenes: Remotion or the capture harness plus FFmpeg
Free and offline pipelines: FFmpeg or Editly
Code-defined React video with its own cloud option: Remotion Lambda
license: Commercial API (paid tiers; free sandbox not verified)

assessment.rationale: Only remote-rendering service among the candidates, with a clear HTTP route and a JSON edit format an agent can generate. Node SDK last published July 2024, so the API is the dependency, not the SDK. Cost and data egress apply.

notes: 2026-10-26: pricing, free sandbox, output format list and service status not verified (API reference not read). Recheck before adoption.
